conviction_note: 0 because Capricorn is no longer an earnings stock. It is under a recommended all-cash scheme offer from DNO at US$5.214 a share (RNS 17 Sep 2026, scheme document posted 21 Sep, Court Meeting 16 Oct, long-stop 1 Mar 2027). At 387p it trades about 1.6% below the offer's sterling value at today's GBPUSD of 1.3255 (about 393p), and that gap is roughly the carry to a Q4 2026/Q1 2027 completion. The day's move will be set by GBPUSD (the stock went 383p to 387p as GBPUSD fell from 1.337 to 1.3255 between 21 and 23 Sep) and by any change in the chance of a deal break or a counter-bid, not by the half-year numbers. The baseline's 4.44% median reaction and its -0.64 run-up lean both come from before the offer and do not apply here.
bar: unsourced. The Yahoo consensus in the baseline has no quarters and there is no published H1 2026 estimate. Irrelevant in practice: the Revised Acquisition Price of US$5.214 cash is fixed, and an interim number cannot move it (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/capricorn-energy--cne/revised-all-cash-offer-for-capricorn-by-dno/9776261). Any size on this name is capped regardless.
session_check: bmo. The issuer's own financial calendar lists '24/09/2026 Half-year results' (https://www.capricornenergy.com/investors/financial-calendar/). Every Capricorn results RNS on record went out at 07:00 London (FY25 on 26 Mar 2026; the H1 2025 release was on 18 Sep 2025 per https://www.capricornenergy.com/investors/results-reports-and-presentations/). One caveat on the baseline: its history row '2025-09-23' does not match the actual H1 2025 release date of 18 Sep 2025.
positioning_check: The FCA aggregated register (as of 2026-09-19) was read and does not name Capricorn: short_ratio_pct 0.0 with no change, anchor_covered false. That is the 0.5% truncation floor, not proof that nobody is short. Holders are arbitrage-heavy: Morgan Stanley went from 10.07% to 11.26% of voting rights on 3 Sep 2026, after the DNO offer (TR-1 of 7 Sep, https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/capricorn-energy--cne/holding-s-in-company/9759438), and Form 8.3 dealing disclosures are filed daily. Any short positions are most likely arbitrage hedges, not a directional view.

outside_window.finding: Court Meeting and General Meeting for the DNO scheme on 16 Oct 2026 (proxy deadline 14 Oct). Approval would narrow the roughly 1.6% arbitrage spread. Timetable is in the scheme-document RNS.

Genel's competing US$4.74 offer has not lapsed, and Genel said on 1 Sep that it was 'considering its position'. No announcement has followed in 22 days. Genel reported cash of US$240m (31 Jul), against a US$396m DNO price, so a counter-bid needs financing. There is no dated trigger for this inside the one-session window.

Completion needs the Egyptian Regulatory Conditions (EGPC consent), and the expected Effective Date is Q4 2026 / Q1 2027 with a long-stop of 1 Mar 2027. Deal-break risk is the only large move left in the name.

baseline_tension: It cuts against both. The +12.83% 20-day and +31.19% 60-day run-ups are the takeover premium being paid, not momentum that could reverse, so neither the -0.64 lean nor the free control carries information here, and the 4.44% reaction scale comes from before the offer.
language_note: The domestic UK RNS record carried the only fact that matters: on Investegate the name has been in a Takeover Code offer period since 11 Mar 2026, with a recommended fixed US-dollar cash scheme. The sealed baseline and the vendor calendar, which is the international view, treat it as an ordinary interim print with a 4.44% reaction scale. The English wire and trade copy (Yahoo, offshore-technology) also carried the deal, but offshore-technology got Genel's status wrong. So the domestic regulated channel added accuracy, not exclusivity.
